source_and_archive_review.elf_byte_review_scope: This new recovery review binds the five reported binary identities to the restored runtime/build receipts. It does not newly read or execute the large ELF archive; root handles that separate recovery and byte review.

steps.name: Allocate fresh native evidence and isolated tool homes
Read only the exact committed history contract and retain source hashes
Fetch the fixed owner and enough ancestry to verify its declared base
Install pinned compilers and original Linux native prerequisites
Build the exact original Agentd and three desktop CLIs with committed locks
Build the source-bound probe and execute real isolated history and storage faults
Preserve final identities and reject changed source even after a failed attempt
Bind successful runtime receipts to five actual ARM64 ELF files
Upload only the qualified ELF bundle and hashes
Preserve actual logs, locks, public fixtures and failure receipts

actual_time_bounds.note: The report timestamp marks initialization before the probe build. The enclosing runtime step includes metadata resolution and a 4m21s probe build, not 4m52s of runtime scenarios.

signature_verification.method: Ed25519 canonical hepta.authbus.signed-message.v1 preimage from pinned source; public key only
signature_verification.meaning: Independent offline byte verification corroborates the recorded isolated requests; it grants no authority.

journal.generation_semantics: The authenticated request body retains original spawn_generation 1; the durable run snapshot generation is current owner generation 2. These are distinct source-defined fields.

harness_response_loss.scope: Harness verified peer identity, wrote one complete original request frame, then intentionally discarded the response without reading any bytes. This is not a hepta-submit CLI lost-reply execution against the original owner.

postpublication_case.inference_scope: Fixed original default run capacity is two. The third fresh compiled Objective publishes before run admission; CapacityExceeded is a source-supported attribution, not a captured CLI error string.

expiry_case.admitted_before_expiry: Actual initial CLI admitted and matching publication #2; fixed probe checks before first submission after re-signing the shortened expiry.

limits: Three controlled Supervisor restarts: one normal restart and two stopped-owner journal mutations. Abrupt process death, power loss and storage durability faults were not executed.
The record logs contain probe observations guarded by the pinned compiled source; individual raw RunStatus and stop-control replies are not separately archived.
Retained caller anchors were preserved independently of owner rollback/truncation. Joint rollback of caller anchor and owner journal was not executed.
Historical publication is not current run liveness, new authorization, resumption or proof of a device effect.
The run uses an isolated issuer and no model turn, Operations dispatch, device effect, canonical intelligence or kernel G1/G2 execution.
The five Objective request identities must not be described as Operations K or D.

script_adaptations.header_added: Recovery date and explicit distinction from lost prior receipt

non_claims: This is a new read-only review of the exact original ARM64 artifact. The 2026-10-18 runtime was not executed again on the recovery date.
The 144684-byte prior final JSON was lost. Its digest is retained only as a historical reference; this newly assembled JSON has its own digest.
Successful Objective publication history does not grant current authority, prove a live run, or demonstrate an Operations/device effect.
The observed post-publication error is generic objective_owner_request_rejected. CapacityExceeded remains a source-supported inference from two active runs and the fixed default capacity.
The lost response was discarded by the original-protocol harness, not by executing the original-owner hepta-submit CLI lost-reply fault.
The three restarts and two storage mutations occurred after controlled owner stops. Abrupt crash, power loss and joint caller-anchor/journal rollback were not exercised.
Production issuer, model turn, historical run resumption, Operations K/D, device effects, canonical intelligence and Asterinas G1/G2 were not exercised.
Five binary identities are read from the restored original receipts here. Actual large-ELF byte recovery and its independent review remain separately owned by root.
This review does not infer a new GitHub test execution, completion of unrelated required aggregates, or any PR merge.
